Repair the buggy source below without changing the required API.

File contract: Write solution.rs with the public function at module scope; use only the standard library.
Required API: pub fn first_min_per_key(keys: &[String], scores: &[i32]) -> Option<Vec<usize>>
Behavior: Reject unequal key and score lengths. For each exact key choose the index with the smallest score, breaking ties by earliest index. Return chosen indices in order of each key's first appearance; empty inputs succeed with a non-null empty result.
Visible example: For keys ["b","a","b","a"] and scores [5,4,3,3], return [2,3].

use std::collections::HashMap;
pub fn first_min_per_key(keys:&[String],scores:&[i32])->Option<Vec<usize>>{if keys.len()!=scores.len(){return None}let mut order=Vec::new();let mut best=HashMap::new();for(i,k)in keys.iter().enumerate(){match best.get(k).copied(){None=>{order.push(k.clone());best.insert(k.clone(),i);},Some(j)=>if scores[i]<scores[j]{best.insert(k.clone(),i);}}}Some(order.iter().map(|k|best[k]).collect())}
